```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(readr)
#Data Set upload
CDI_2025_table <- read_csv("CDI_2025_table.csv")

CDI_2026_table <- read_csv("CDI_2026_table.csv")

outcome_table <- read_csv("outcome_table.csv")

CDI_ML_2025_2026 <- read_csv("CDI_ML_2025_2026.csv")

```

```{r libraries}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidymodels)
library(broom)

tidymodels_prefer()
set.seed(123)

```

```{r ml datasets}
ml_2025 <- CDI_ML_2025_2026 %>%
  transmute(
    pitcher,
    pitcher_name,
    CDI = CDI_2025,
    xERA = xERA_2025
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(CDI),
    is.finite(xERA)
  )

ml_2026 <- CDI_ML_2025_2026 %>%
  transmute(
    pitcher,
    pitcher_name,
    CDI = CDI_2026,
    xERA = xERA_2026
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(CDI),
    is.finite(xERA)
  )
```


## Linear Relationship between CDI-xERA

```{r lr 2025}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(
  ml_2025,
  aes(
    x = CDI,
    y = xERA
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.65,
    color = "steelblue",
    size = 2
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    color = "red",
    fill = "pink",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2025 CDI vs. xERA",
    subtitle = "Relationship between Composite Development Index and Expected ERA",
    x = "Composite Development Index (CDI)",
    y = "Expected ERA (xERA)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

```{r Pearson 2025}
cor(
  ml_2025$CDI,
  ml_2025$xERA,
  use = "complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)
```

```{r Spearman 2025}
cor(
  ml_2025$CDI,
  ml_2025$xERA,
  use = "complete.obs",
  method = "spearman"
)
```
# Repeated Cross Validation Folds
```{r repeated folds}
set.seed(123)

cv_folds_2025 <- vfold_cv(
  ml_2025,
  v = 10,
  repeats = 10,
  strata = xERA
)

cv_folds_2025

```


## Pre Processing
```{r prepro}
cdi_recipe <- recipe(
  xERA ~ CDI,
  data = ml_2025
) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors())

```

## Baseline Linear Model
```{r Baseline}
linear_spec <- linear_reg() %>%
  set_engine("lm")

linear_workflow <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(cdi_recipe) %>%
  add_model(linear_spec)

```


## Cross-validation
```{r cross val}
set.seed(123)

linear_cv_results <- fit_resamples(
  linear_workflow,
  resamples = cv_folds_2025,
  metrics = metric_set(
    rmse,
    mae,
    rsq
  ),
  control = control_resamples(
    save_pred = TRUE
  )
)

collect_metrics(linear_cv_results)

```

## Examine Cross Validated Predictions
```{r linear cv predictions}
linear_cv_predictions <- collect_predictions(
  linear_cv_results
)

head(linear_cv_predictions)

```

```{r linear cv plot}
ggplot(
  linear_cv_predictions,
  aes(x = .pred, y = xERA)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.45) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Cross-Validated 2025 CDI Model",
    subtitle = "Predicted versus actual 2025 xERA",
    x = "Predicted xERA",
    y = "Actual xERA"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)


```

## Fit & Freeze Final Model

```{r fit}
final_linear_model <- fit(
  linear_workflow,
  data = ml_2025
)
final_linear_model
```

```{r extract coes}
linear_coefficients <- final_linear_model %>%
  extract_fit_parsnip() %>%
  tidy()

linear_coefficients

```



```{r model glance}
linear_model_glance <- final_linear_model %>%
  extract_fit_parsnip() %>%
  glance()

linear_model_glance

```

$$\hat{\mathrm{xERA}} = 4.128 - 1.107(\mathrm{CDI})$$

## Apply to 2026 CDI
```{r test cdi}
predictions_2026 <- predict(
  final_linear_model,
  new_data = ml_2026
) %>%
  bind_cols(ml_2026) %>%
  rename(
    predicted_xERA_2026 = .pred,
    actual_xERA_2026 = xERA,
    CDI_2026 = CDI
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    residual = actual_xERA_2026 - predicted_xERA_2026,
    absolute_error = abs(residual),
    squared_error = residual^2
  )

```

```{r results 2026}
predictions_2026 %>%
  arrange(absolute_error) %>%
  head(20)

```


$$\text{Residual} = \text{Actual xERA} - \text{Predicted xERA}$$

## Evaluate on actual 2026 xERA
```{r evaluate}
test_metrics_2026 <- predictions_2026 %>%
  metrics(
    truth = actual_xERA_2026,
    estimate = predicted_xERA_2026
  )

test_metrics_2026

```
```{r evaluate 2}
predictive_r2_2026 <- 1 -
  sum(
    (predictions_2026$actual_xERA_2026 -
       predictions_2026$predicted_xERA_2026)^2
  ) /
  sum(
    (predictions_2026$actual_xERA_2026 -
       mean(predictions_2026$actual_xERA_2026))^2
  )

predictive_r2_2026

```
## Actual vs Predicted Plot
```{r A vs P Plot}
ggplot(
  predictions_2026,
  aes(
    x = predicted_xERA_2026,
    y = actual_xERA_2026
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.65) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Out-of-Season Validation of CDI",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Model trained on 2025 and evaluated on 2026; R² = ",
      round(predictive_r2_2026, 3)
    ),
    x = "Predicted 2026 xERA",
    y = "Actual 2026 xERA"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

## Test Calibration
```{r calibration}
calibration_2026 <- lm(
  actual_xERA_2026 ~ predicted_xERA_2026,
  data = predictions_2026
)

summary(calibration_2026)
tidy(calibration_2026)

```

```{r prediction bias}
predictions_2026 %>%
  summarise(
    mean_actual = mean(actual_xERA_2026),
    mean_predicted = mean(predicted_xERA_2026),
    mean_error = mean(
      predicted_xERA_2026 - actual_xERA_2026
    )
  )

```

## Comparison Against Simple Baseline

```{r base}
baseline_xERA_2025 <- mean(
  ml_2025$xERA,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

baseline_results_2026 <- ml_2026 %>%
  mutate(
    baseline_prediction = baseline_xERA_2025
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    RMSE = sqrt(
      mean(
        (xERA - baseline_prediction)^2,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    ),
    MAE = mean(
      abs(xERA - baseline_prediction),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )
baseline_results_2026
```

```{r base 2}

cdi_results_2026 <- predictions_2026 %>%
  summarise(
    RMSE = sqrt(
      mean(
        (actual_xERA_2026 - predicted_xERA_2026)^2
      )
    ),
    MAE = mean(
      abs(actual_xERA_2026 - predicted_xERA_2026)
    )
  )

model_comparison <- bind_rows(
  Baseline = baseline_results_2026,
  CDI_Model = cdi_results_2026,
  .id = "Model"
)
model_comparison
```

## Largest Prediction Misses
```{r misses}
largest_errors_2026 <- predictions_2026 %>%
  arrange(desc(absolute_error)) %>%
  select(
    pitcher,
    pitcher_name,
    CDI_2026,
    predicted_xERA_2026,
    actual_xERA_2026,
    residual,
    absolute_error
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

largest_errors_2026

```
